title: {{NAME}} and the Dinosaur Garden Full of Fairies
moral: Small and big can be the best of friends.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a teal t-shirt with a purple dinosaur print, lime green shorts, and orange sneakers — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content: {{NAME}} found a garden behind the old stone wall. The flowers were huge and bright. Tiny lights floated between the petals. The ground shook just a little. Then a big friendly dinosaur walked in.

pages.content: The dinosaur was called Rex. Rex loved fairies. But every time he came near, his big feet knocked over the flowers. The fairies had to fly away fast. Rex looked down at his big feet and frowned.

pages.content: {{NAME}} had an idea. He asked Rex to sit very still. Then he called out to the fairies. He said, Rex is kind. He will not move. Please come back. The fairies flew toward them slowly.

pages.content: One brave fairy landed on Rex's big nose. Rex held very still. He was so happy he had a tiny tear in one eye. More fairies landed on his head and his back. They tickled him a little.

pages.content: Rex and the fairies played together every day after that. They looked after each other. Small and big can be the best of friends. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep tight. One fairy whispered that they were building something magical in the middle of the garden. What could it be?
